# `candid import`

Import your own data exports (mbox, LinkedIn ZIP, ...).

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid import [-h] [--gmail-takeout FILE.mbox] [--linkedin-zip FILE.zip] [--mode {merge,replace}] [--max MAX]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--gmail-takeout` `FILE.mbox` | Google Takeout mbox file (or directory of .mbox files) |
| `--linkedin-zip` `FILE.zip` | LinkedIn official data-export archive |
| `--mode` `MODE` | LinkedIn import mode (default: merge) (default: merge) |
| `--max` `MAX` | Max mbox messages to read (0 = all) |
